seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Two mirror axes on a 3x3 block grid (x=row): H wall row, V wall column, movable pieces; A5 cycles H->V->pieces(by min block)->H.
A1/A2 move H or the selected piece by -/+1 block row; A3/A4 move V or the piece by -/+1 block col; axes limited by the board only, pieces by the board and other pieces.
Visible gray reflection across V at (r,2av-c); invisible occluders across H and HV; no reflections on piece blocks; layers piece>refl>inv>target>V>H.
Re-extract by colour: wall/player = 4-connected components of own cells plus all 0 cells, ranked by bbox; targets merged while bbox gap<=3 (gap 4 stays separate, steps 254/266).
Unconfirmed (never observed): a piece on the H row gets an invisible V mirror; pieces that touch are taken from the objects, so they would merge. Stateless; counter is static.
